content:
A heads-up before the numbers: this picture is 75 days old, last updated 2026-03-29, so treat what follows as a March snapshot, not a live read.

**The goal:** €25,000 still to save for the piso deposit by January 2029 — roughly 34 months away. Your free cash flow as of that snapshot was €1,309/month. If all of that reached the goal, you'd overshoot comfortably. The real question is how much of that €1,309 is actually being set aside versus absorbed by day-to-day spending.

The data is thin — only 10 transactions across 88 days — so patterns aren't established yet. What is visible: **health** dominated tracked spend at €2,565 over the window, which is worth watching as the dataset fills out. It may be one-off or structural; right now there isn't enough history to call it.

On the bills side, movistar fusión at €58/month sits above the typical Spain range of €25–€35 — not a directive, just worth keeping in view as the margin tightens.

The one lever the data has sized: trimming **eating & drinking out** by €19/month frees up a small but confirmed amount. It won't move the goal date on its own, but it's a clean first move while the picture sharpens.

[CTA:cut_lever]Trim 19 from eating & drinking out[/CTA]

— C.
